newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower on rate cut.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) mellowed in most maturities on Friday after the Central Bank dropped its overnight borrowing rate to 10.0 percent from 10.25 percent, traders said.
Only the one-year rate was unchanged.

The Central Bank's cut was the second in the week, bringing the total cut in the week to 0.4375 percentage point. The series of cuts was a result of a steep drop in the benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate on Monday to 10.159 from 10.564 percent due to high liquidity in the market.
